name: Senan (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with a white crescent with its horns upward surmounted by a white fleur-de-lis.
history: The official flag of Senan is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, green, with the white crescent surmounted by a white fleur-de-lis, the whole of height 7/9 of the cloth; approved on 9 September 1991 and published in the DOGC on 25 September 1991, based on the arms of the town.
